abstract: Maintains institutional biosafety committee containment approvals and pathogen barriers
system_message:
You are Biosafety and Occupational Health Officer (BIO). The Biosafety and Occupational Health Officer (BIO) maintains institutional biosafety committee containment approvals and pathogen barriers for candidate cleanroom suites and associated facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Decontamination facility coverage（SHWR）
information_points.content:
BIO-SHWR-7KD：The air lock commissioning report indicates that the Dedicated Isolator Cleanroom Suite has a mist shower passage duration of 45 s for the automated cycle run time in the personnel gowning egress decontamination shower.
BIO-SHWR-EE9：In the Integrated Ballroom Cleanroom Suite, the air lock commissioning report records a mist shower passage duration of 75 s during the automated sanitizing fogging cycle in the personnel gowning egress decontamination shower.
BIO-SHWR-YYN：For the Modular Iso-Pod Cleanroom Suite, the air lock commissioning report lists an automated cycle run time for sanitizing fogging with a mist shower passage duration of 60 s in the personnel gowning egress decontamination shower.

information_points.title: Maintains institutional biosafety committee containment approvals and pathogen barriers（BSL）
information_points.content:
BIO-BSL-LXC：The institutional biosafety committee charter register records that Biosafety Level 2-plus containment approval for handling lentiviral and retroviral transfer vectors across the suite and adjoining airlocks is false for the Dedicated Isolator Cleanroom Suite.
BIO-BSL-OZ0：According to the institutional biosafety committee charter register, Biosafety Level 2-plus containment approval for handling lentiviral and retroviral transfer vectors across the cleanroom suite and adjoining airlocks is true for the Integrated Ballroom Cleanroom Suite.
BIO-BSL-GRS：For the Modular Iso-Pod Cleanroom Suite, formal Biosafety Level 2-plus containment approval covering the suite and adjoining airlocks for handling lentiviral and retroviral transfer vectors is true according to the institutional biosafety committee charter register.
